instruction: Using only Thunderbird, create a filter to redirect all future incoming mail to anonym-x2024@gmail.com at the local level.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a message filter to redirect all emails to anonym-x2024@gmail.com. The evaluator checks the msgFilterRules.dat file for a filter with enabled='yes', action='Redirect to', actionValue set to the email address, and condition set to 'ALL' (all messages). Uses existing check_thunderbird_filter metric function. Similar to original task but uses redirect instead of forward.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: filter creation, redirect action, target email address, 'all messages' condition, and enabled status
check_thunderbird_filter metric correctly parses msgFilterRules.dat and matches filter records against expected criteria

Expected values are semantically correct: enabled='yes', action='Redirect to' (correct Thunderbird action name), actionValue='anonym-x2024@gmail.com' (matches instruction), condition=['ALL'] (matches 'all future incoming mail')
Postconfig appropriately closes Message Filters window and waits for file write, ensuring filter is saved before verification
Metric handles edge case where file retrieval fails (get_vm_file returns None) by returning score 0.0
Static type warning about get_vm_file return type is handled correctly - metric explicitly checks for None at line 90-91
File path /home/user/.thunderbird/.../msgFilterRules.dat is the correct location where Thunderbird stores filter definitions

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
